scope: Known authoritative geometry blockers after public-source discovery closure

blockers.authority: Junta de Andalucia - REDIAM / Ventana del Visitante
blockers.blocker: HTTP 403 / inaccessible WFS response from GitHub Actions and external fetch environments
blockers.finding: The KML/GML download actions exposed by live Ventana del Visitante route pages resolve to the same REDIAM WFS GetFeature endpoint filtered by CODIGOEQUI. They are not independent static-file downloads.
blockers.required_next_action: Run the existing REDIAM geometry auditor from an environment accepted by the Junta WFS, or obtain the authoritative geometry through an official Junta/REDIAM data delivery endpoint.
blockers.unsafe_workaround_forbidden: Do not fabricate geometry from map screenshots or community tracks.

blockers.authority: Ayuntamiento de Mancha Real - Turismo Mancha Real
blockers.blocker: TLS certificate hostname mismatch on archivos.campusfortalezas.com
blockers.required_next_action: Re-run the municipal KML audit after the provider serves a certificate valid for archivos.campusfortalezas.com, or obtain the same KML artifacts through an authoritative correctly served endpoint.
blockers.unsafe_workaround_forbidden: Do not disable TLS certificate verification to claim geometry validation.

blockers.authority: Diputacion de Jaen - Jaen Paraiso Interior
blockers.blocker: No explicit public authoritative GPX/KML/KMZ artifact located on the official route sources
blockers.required_next_action: Use a future official GIS/API/public download or direct institutional data delivery if Diputacion publishes/provides the geometry.
blockers.unsafe_workaround_forbidden: Do not infer track URLs from R1/R2/R3/R6/R7/R9 naming patterns.

blockers.authority: Noalejo, Carcheles, La Guardia de Jaen, Campillo de Arenas and Cabra del Santo Cristo institutional sources
blockers.blocker: No public authoritative GPX/KML/KMZ artifact located during the closed discovery pass
blockers.required_next_action: Accept future official municipal GIS/API/download publication or direct institutional geometry delivery.
blockers.unsafe_workaround_forbidden: Do not promote Wikiloc/community/third-party tracks to official evidence.

closure.note: Remaining gaps are source-access/publication constraints, not unperformed public-source discovery.
